title: CLCON/384/2016 of N B Minerals Corporation Vs Pramod Mahajan AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No. 384 of 2016
U.C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for the
petitioner.
It is the submission of learned counsel
for the petitioner that there is willful
disobedience of Court's order dated
18.05.2016, passed in WPMS no. 1381 of 2016
(Annexure-1 to the petition).
One of the objectives of contempt
jurisdiction is to ensure compliance of court's
order and, therefore, instead of issuing notice to
the respondents / contemnors, this Court
reiterates the order dated 18.05.2016 and directs
respondent no. 1 Conservator of Forests, North
Circle Kumaon, Almora to decide the
representation of the petitioner by a reasoned
and speaking order, in accordance with law,
within 4 weeks of presentation of certified copy
of this order, failing which contempt
proceedings may be initiated against him.
Let a copy of this order be supplied to
learned counsel for the petitioner within 24
hours to ensure service of the same on the
respondent / contemnor, within a week.
With the direction as above, the contempt
petition stands disposed of.
